_comment: hk_root_descriptor_table of Mesa 25.3.x, inferred from the preambles the M2's driver (Mesa 25.3.6, driver_version
104869894) compiled for all 177 recorded workloads in spirv/expected/*/code. Word = 32-bit word index.
Every root load agrees with 26.0 (spirv/root_layout.mesa-26.0.json) except the push constants: u0_u1 = the table's
own address, u2_u3.. = sets[0..set_count) preloaded by the driver, group_count_addr at words 18..19 (indirect
dispatch, loaded by aluprobe/geom3d/hist_eq/barriercost/coalesce/smembank), base_group at words 20..22 (173
workloads), descriptors read through u2_u3 at the same set offsets as 26.0 -- but push word n is root word 124 + n
(26.0: 122 + n), for every push load seen (words 124..129 scalar/vector, pushmat 124..187). So the draw arm of
the cs/draw union in front of push is 8 bytes longer in 25.3. root_bytes = 26.0's + 8, assuming the tail
(dynamic buffers, set_dynamic_buffer_start) is unchanged; no recorded workload reads past the push constants.
